component.name: Minimalist Drawing
component.summary: Fast, minimalist infinite canvas drawing and scratchpad application

description.p: Minimalist Drawing is a high-performance, minimalist infinite canvas drawing application built with PyQt6. Designed for rapid sketching, problem solving, note-taking, and brainstorming.

ul.li: Smooth Quad-Bezier antialiased strokes with pen, highlighter, and eraser
Instant Clear Screen button with full undo/redo history
Geometric shape auto-correction (lines, circles, ellipses, rectangles, triangles)
Dark and light canvas themes with semantic ink inversion
Infinite canvas pan and zoom with QuadTree spatial acceleration
Lasso selection, move, scale, copy, and paste
Lossless PNG export and image insertion

description.p: Initial release of Minimalist Drawing for Linux with standalone binary, Arch PKGBUILD, and Debian package.
